article.headline: Neto's 25 lead Boise State over Butler 100-81
article.description: — Aginaldo Neto had 25 points in Boise State's 100-81 win over Butler on Sunday.
article.linkText: Neto's 25 lead Boise State over Butler 100-81
article.story: BOISE, Idaho -- — Aginaldo Neto had 25 points in Boise State's 100-81 win over Butler on Sunday. Neto added six rebounds, five assists, and three steals for the Broncos (2-0). Spencer Ahrens scored 24 points and added five rebounds. Dovydas Butka shot 5 of 11 from the field and 4 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 14 points. Eduardo Klafke and Jalen Jackson each scored 19 points for the Bulldogs (2-1). Jordan Ellerbee finished with 16 points. Boise State took the lead with 19:24 left in the first half and did not trail again. Neto led his team in scoring with 16 points in the first half to help put them up 51-31 at the break. Ahrens scored 21 points in the second half to help lead the way. Up next Boise State plays Wednesday against Oakland at home. Butler hosts Pittsburgh on Friday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
